messages:
mira: Heads-up — after the canary rollout this morning I saw a bunch of short-lived streaming sessions and billing duplicates. Looks tied to clients sending a new `Conn-Update` header right after auth refresh. Anyone else seeing this?

dylan: Yep. Console telemetry shows a spike in "resume" counts + duplicate charge events around 08:12 UTC. Sessions reopen in <500ms bursts.

sam: Do you have a trace id or a minimal repro?

mira: Trace: `trace-8a2f`. Quick repro: client refreshes token -> sends `Conn-Update: session=abc123;ts=...` -> old socket gets torn down, new socket opens. Proxy+router both count it as a distinct billable session before dedupe kicks in.

mira: curl example from repro:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <refreshed>" -H "Conn-Update: session=abc123;seq=4" https://stream.redwood.example/events
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rolled: r-inference v3.2.1 -> canary-12 at 08:00 UTC

dylan: My theory: `Conn-Update` is racing with the edge routing sticky-lease refresh. Router accepts new conn then the quota-window aggregator still attributes tokens to old session for ~1s, resulting in duplicate counts.

mira: Telemetry timeline backs that up: new socket connected (08:12:14.123) -> proxy closed old (08:12:14.141) -> billing event emitted for both (14.142 + 14.143).

sam: Two immediate mitigation ideas: server-side debounce for `Conn-Update` (ignore if same session id within X ms) or make `Conn-Update` idempotent by session+seq.

dylan: Also console UX: collapse reconnects shorter than N ms into one session group. Right now the UI shows them as independent sessions and product folks panic.

console-ui: We can add a "session group" toggle that groups by session id + 2s sliding window. Will prototype — should reduce noise in the live dashboard.

mira: Proposed server-side debounce patch (very small):
```
last = lookup_last_conn_update(session)
if now - last < 250ms:
  // ignore header and keep routing
  return
else:
  accept_conn_update()
```
Notes: 250ms is a starting point; should be tunable via feature flag per-route.

sam: +1 for feature-flagged approach. Add a metric `conn_debounce_applied` so we can see how often we throttle legit updates.

dylan: Also need to smooth billing aggregator window from 1s -> 3-5s for streaming resume dedupe. That will add a tiny latency in attribution but prevent double-counts. Product asked for a precise cost delta before we ship.

mira: I'll open PR for the debounce + metric and a follow-up to increase the aggregator window behind a rollout flag: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4321 (WIP).

sam: Add unit tests for: same-session rapid conn-update -> debounced; different-session conn-update -> accepted. And an integration test that simulates edge routing jitter.

deploy-bot: ops: scheduling canary rollout for `conn_debounce_ms=250` on canary-12 at 09:30 UTC.

dylan: For dashboards: add panel for "deduped billing events" and a trace-link from billing spike -> session group. That makes postmortems easier.

console-ui: Will add a collapsed panel and a new sample rate for traces (increase from 0.1 -> 1.0 for grouped reconnects during the canary).

mira: OK will land PR with flags and dashboard patch, then coordinate a canary with observability on.

sam: Sounds good. If anyone sees weird production behavior after canary, ping #eng-oncall and include `trace-8a2f` example.

mira: Thanks all :tada:

dylan: :thumbsup:

console-ui: noted — will post mockups in ~1hr.

ops-bot: monitoring: added alert for bursty-reconnects > 50/min for a tenant (threshold currently off)
